# MUS-W-0006

**The mandate, in Mustur's own repository-local configuration**

work-unit · 2026-08-19

Discharges: [MUS-M-0002](../milestones.md#mus-m-0002)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0002](../decisions.md#mus-d-0002), [MUS-D-0008](../decisions.md#mus-d-0008), [MUS-D-0027](../decisions.md#mus-d-0027)

## Context

Mustur is its own first project, so the injection kit is exercised here before it is offered to anything else.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0005.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0002: Mustur's own repository-local configuration carries the mandate.

## Done means

The server is registered in a committed, repository-scoped file rather than on any account.
The mandate clause in the repository's context file is the wording the disproof scored, extended only by what to do when the tool is absent.
The clause names the tool and the server, and never appears in a task prompt.
A session that finds no tool says so and continues, rather than stopping or pretending the call was made.

## Risks

A mandate in this repository's context file fires in every session here, including sessions where the server is not running. Wording it to degrade weakens exactly the pressure the disproof measured, and the trade is taken knowingly: an absent tool reported is worth more than a session that cannot start.
The clause is prose in a file a person edits. Nothing checks that it still says what was measured.
